{{Top|leg}}
'''Robo-flagwavers''' were stationary [[Droid/Legends|droids]] placed at either end of road construction sites to warn oncoming ground vehicle traffic of the impending road conditions. They were pre-programmed for a perpetual cycle of signaling, until the project was completed and they were removed.
